open_positions.thesis: AEIS is trading well above its 200SMA at $274.40 confirming the longer-term uptrend, but RSI at 41.9 and price 9.7% below the 50SMA at $344.73 suggest a mean-reversion bounce setup. The stock is in a pullback within an uptrend, offering a favorable risk/reward for a swing back toward the 50SMA.

JOBY has RSI at 37.5 approaching oversold territory with price well below both the 50SMA ($9.89) and 200SMA ($12.29), indicating heavy selling. At extreme fear levels, beaten-down speculative names often see sharp relief rallies. A bounce toward the 50SMA represents a 16% move with a tight stop.

RXRX has rallied to RSI 64.6 approaching overbought while still trading below its 200SMA at $4.10, which should act as resistance. The stock is 14.5% above its 50SMA at $3.32, suggesting the recent run is extended. A fade toward the 50SMA is likely as the rally meets overhead resistance.

PLUG is sitting right on its 200SMA at $2.63 which is acting as support, with RSI at 38.7 approaching oversold territory. Price is deeply discounted from the 50SMA at $3.22, creating a mean-reversion setup toward $3.00+ if support holds. Extreme Fear sentiment adds contrarian tailwind.

CELH has been trending above its 50SMA ($30.66) with RSI at 62.2 showing momentum without being overbought. The stock has room to run toward the $36-37 zone before hitting resistance, and consumer staples names tend to outperform in fearful markets. Clean trend structure above the 50-day moving average.

AVAV is consolidating right at its 50SMA ($175.01) with a neutral RSI of 53.4, setting up a potential breakout from this base. Defense stocks carry secular tailwinds and the stock is deeply undervalued relative to its 200SMA at $253.88, suggesting significant upside recovery potential on any catalyst.

CAVA is approaching oversold territory with RSI at 34.9 and price sitting right at its 200SMA of $70.40, a critical long-term support level. A bounce from this confluence zone toward the 50SMA at $81.68 offers strong risk/reward. The stock has been compressed 14.6% below its 50SMA, creating mean-reversion potential.

MRVL is holding above its 50SMA at $226.77 with RSI at 43.5, suggesting neutral-to-mildly-oversold conditions with room to run. Price is well above the 200SMA at $124.27, confirming a strong long-term uptrend. A pullback to the 50SMA area offers a high-probability swing entry targeting recent momentum resumption.

With QQQ dropping 1.85% today and broad tech selling accelerating, SQQQ offers a tactical hedge or short-term momentum play. Fear sentiment at 27 and Microsoft layoffs signal continued tech weakness in the near term. Momentum is clearly with sellers in the Nasdaq, favoring further upside in this inverse vehicle.

NVAX is sitting right at its 50SMA ($9.23) with a neutral RSI of 51, well above its 200SMA ($8.54). In an Extreme Fear environment, biotech names with stable technicals and no earnings imminent can see mean-reversion bounces. The setup targets a push toward the $10.50 level as a measured move off the 200SMA support base.

CRSP is trading above both its 50SMA ($53.16) and 200SMA ($55.56) with RSI at 60.6 — strong but not overbought. The stock has shown relative strength versus the broad market selloff. A continuation toward $64 is the measured target as the uptrend from the 50SMA base remains intact.

SOFI is trading well below its 200SMA ($22.19) which acts as heavy overhead resistance, while the RSI at 52.5 shows no oversold bounce catalyst. In an Extreme Fear environment with financials under pressure from rising rates, a fade toward the 50SMA at $16.84 is the higher probability move. Short entry near current levels with a target of $16.50.

SLV dropped 2.99% today in a sharp pullback that likely represents profit-taking rather than a trend reversal given the inflationary oil spike and Extreme Fear environment. Precious metals tend to find bids during fear-driven selloffs. A bounce back toward $55 is the near-term target on a mean-reversion play.
